name: Pilot Bellowfiz
summary: Pilot Bellowfiz, affectionately known as 'Fizzer,' is a dwarven driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. As a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, he is responsible for maintaining and fielding heavy dwarven war machines, specifically his own siege engine, Jetsteam.

sections.title: Master of the Jetsteam
sections.body: Stationed just outside the bustling halls of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz represents the mechanical backbone of the dwarven military. Piloting the powerful siege engine known as Jetsteam, Bellowfiz spends his days tuning components, procuring essential parts, and keeping his machine battle-ready. Alongside his comrade Pilot Stonegear, Bellowfiz is constantly discussing vehicular designs, armor plating, and engine output, ensuring that the mountain kingdom's mechanized firepower remains unmatched across Khaz Modan.

faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz is a dwarf pilot serving in the Ironforge Siege Brigade. Located at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, he maintains and operates heavy siege engines for the defense of Khaz Modan.

aliases: what siege engine does bellowfiz pilot
faq.answer: He pilots a dwarven siege engine named Jetsteam. He frequently works to stock it with replacement parts, specialized gear, and maintenance supplies to keep it running smoothly.

faq.q: Where can Pilot Bellowfiz be found?
faq.answer: You can find him stationed in the snow at Steelgrill's Depot, an engineering and staging yard just down the road east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What does he do with Pilot Stonegear?
faq.answer: Bellowfiz and Pilot Stonegear are fellow drivers in the Siege Brigade. When not taking care of their vehicles, the two often banter and debate the fine points of siege engine design, armor, and mechanics.

angles.text: For dwarven and gnomish tinkerers, Bellowfiz represents the pinnacle of practical field engineering—keeping high-powered siege engines functional in the freezing mountain weather.
Bellowfiz embodies the pride of Ironforge's mechanized brigades, showcasing the engineering prowess and heavy firepower that safeguard Khaz Modan.
